rationale: J10 (2026-09-30). An accessor pair is a prototype member, so a subclass accessor DOES shadow a base accessor of the same name — the lane emitted nothing for it because accessors are kinded `property` and `overrides` was scoped to Methods and Constructors. The omission was found by building the J9 oracle and reading its MISSING rows: 12 of them, all in svelte/src/reactivity/url.js, where `class SvelteURL extends URL` re-declares twelve URL.prototype members as accessor pairs. Pins three things. (1) The positive case, or the cheap fix is to suppress accessors entirely. (2) The get/set PAIR collapsing to ONE edge — deduping only the verified in-file branch doubled every accessor guess instead, visible as SvelteURL.hash at both line 77 (get) and line 81 (set). (3) The negative case: an accessor over a member the base does not have is still refused, so widening the rule does not degrade into treating every accessor as an override. J9's private-name rule is pinned here too, to show the two hold together: a private accessor is still silent.

expectRelationships.note: the accessor pair collapses to ONE edge; `URL` really declares `hash`, so this is a real override confirmed against the builtin prototype chain
a plain method is unaffected by the widening — the fix must not change method behaviour

forbidRelationships.note: being an accessor is not sufficient; the builtin prototype chain confirms URL has no such member, so the accessor shape alone must not fabricate an override
J9 outranks J10: a private accessor is class-scoped, installed per instance, never on the prototype — so it still cannot override

expectSymbolCount.name: hash
expectSymbolCount.note: the get and set pair are two SYMBOLS; they are one OVERRIDE. The distinction is the point of this fixture.

expectRelationshipCount.note: the get/set PAIR is ONE override. This is the assertion that makes the dedup load-bearing: the first attempt at J10 deduplicated only the verified in-file branch, so every accessor guess was emitted TWICE and this suite still passed, because expectRelationships only requires >=1 match.
